subject: Invoice pathing, tax responsibility and commit tranche — Novatech order form
messages:
From: Alice Moran <alice@novatech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on invoice routing and tax for upcoming order form

Hi Ben / Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving toward signature on the order form but finance has a couple of questions before we can issue the PO:

- We need the invoice split to reflect the three-tranche commit schedule (Q2/Q3/Q4) rather than a single advance invoice. Can Redwood accommodate three separate invoices tied to each tranche?
- Tax: Novatech is VAT-registered in the EU and will need the invoice to show VAT reverse-charge where applicable. Which party will be responsible for VAT reporting and is Redwood able to issue invoices with VAT line items (we can provide VAT cert).
- Net terms: our procurement prefers Net-45. Is Net-30 required by Redwood or negotiable for this deal size?

I've attached Novatech's draft PO template and a short note from our finance team. Please let us know the path to make these changes so we can get this over the finish line.

Attachments: Novatech_PO_template.pdf (attached by sender)

Thanks,
Alice

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers: yes on tranche invoices (we can bill per-commit tranche), VAT handling depends on your VAT registration and the billing entity; and net terms are negotiable — I’ll confirm with finance/legal.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll loop in Hannah (commercial lead) and our finance partner to confirm net terms and whether we need to issue multiple invoices or a single master invoice with tranche line items.
2) If VAT reverse-charge is needed, please send the VAT cert (PDF) and we'll route to our billing team.
3) If there are small contractual redlines to the order form payment section, can you mark them in the document and send back? We can accept minor language edits but will surface anything material to legal.

I’ve copied Hannah who will coordinate the internal signoffs.

Folks — forwarding Novatech's ask. TL;DR: they want three invoices aligned to tranche commits, VAT reverse-charge for EU entity, and Net-45 request.

Rishi — can legal confirm whether we can agree to:
- Invoice per tranche (billing to be tied to tranche delivery date);
- Net-45 for this enterprise deal (Ben has commercial flexibility but want legal okay on payment default language);
- Any required order-form language to show tax responsibility (we need a clean clause that says customer is responsible for VAT where reverse-charge applies and Redwood will supply standard tax IDs on invoices).

Laura — can finance confirm operationally whether we can produce separate invoices for the three tranches and whether that changes revenue recognition / collections cadence? If we need to do a single invoice with tranche line items, flag that too.

Alice — attaching our proposed redline of the order form payment section (Novatech_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx) and a draft clause for VAT responsibilities. If Novatech provides the VAT certificate we can add the reverse-charge language.

Attachments: Novatech_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (Redline from Redwood commercial)

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Moran <alice@novatech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 12:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FW: Questions on invoice routing and tax for upcoming order form

Hannah / team — quick legal read below. I reviewed the attached redline and propose the following, which is conservative but customer-friendly: 

1) Invoice cadence: Acceptable to issue separate invoices per tranche. We will add language to the order form Exhibit A (Billing) stating: "Redwood will issue an invoice for each committed tranche on the billing dates set forth in the Order Form. Each invoice will reference the relevant tranche and shall be payable in accordance with the agreed net terms."

2) Net terms: We can approve Net-45 for this customer on this deal, provided we retain Redwood's standard late-payment remedy and interest language. I added a payment default clause referencing interest at 1.25% per month (or the maximum lawful rate).

3) VAT / taxes: We will include a tax responsibility clause: "Customer is responsible for indirect taxes (including VAT) arising from the purchase. If Customer provides a valid VAT registration certificate demonstrating eligibility for reverse-charge, Redwood will omit VAT on the invoice and include the Customer's VAT ID and a reference to reverse-charge. If Customer is outside the scope, Redwood will charge applicable taxes." Please confirm Novatech's VAT country and provide certificate.

4) Operational note: For separate tranche invoices, finance must confirm whether to treat the invoices as separate receivables or as attachments to a single AR reference. If finance prefers single AR tracking, legal suggests we still label invoices per tranche but include a single PO number.

I attached a short redline excerpt with the clause language. Nothing else material.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
